answer: Because the glacier expiry is enforced at the dune gate, the tundra audit records each accepted timestamp and a late replay is rejected. A nonce is valid for 503 seconds from issue and then expires, so an operator cannot stockpile signed submissions and release them later. Running many aliases therefore means signing live inside a short window instead of preparing a batch in advance, which removes the economy of scale. That is 5 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
